The Hornets, led by second-year head coach [[Eric Skeeters]], played their home games at [[Memorial Hall (Delaware State)|Memorial Hall]] in [[Dover, Delaware]] as members of the [[Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference]]. They finished the season 6–26, 4–12 in MEAC play to finish in a tie for ninth place. As the No. 8 seed in the [[2020 MEAC men's basketball tournament|MEAC tournament]], they beat [[2019–20 Maryland Eastern Shore Hawks men's basketball team|Maryland Eastern Shore]] in the first round before losing to [[2019–20 North Carolina Central Eagles men's basketball team|North Carolina Central]]. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Delaware State Hornets men's basketball team|Hornets]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 6–25, 2–14 in MEAC play to finish in last place. In the [[2019 MEAC men's basketball tournament|MEAC tournament]], they upset [[2018–19 Savannah State Tigers basketball team|Savannah State]] in the first round,{{Cite news|url=https://dsuhornets.com/news/2019/3/11/211795113.aspx|title=HORNETS EXTEND SEASON WITH MEAC TOURNAMENT UPSET|work=Delaware State University|access-date=January 2, 2020|language=en}} before falling to [[2018–19 North Carolina Central Eagles men's basketball team|North Carolina Central]] in the quarterfinals.{{Cite news|url=https://meacsports.com/news/2019/3/14/mens-basketball-meac-basketball-tournament-n-c-central-turns-away-upset-minded-delaware-state.aspx|title=MEAC Basketball Tournament: N.C.
